Play Top Gun in Season 4 for free starting August 18.

Take to the skies and become the best of the best. The Top Gun update arrives in Battlefield 6 on August 18, bringing high-speed aerial combat, legendary battlefields, and new ways to dominate the Pacific.

Pilot the new F/A-81F Super Spectre and F-74A Seacat two-seat fighter jets with your wingman, master intense dogfights in Gauntlet: Fighter Sweep, and fight across land, sea, and air in the reimagined Carrier Strike. Return to the iconic Wake Island, rebuilt for Battlefield 6 with large-scale combined-arms combat across its beaches, bunkers, and surrounding waters.

Complete event challenges to earn Top Gun-themed rewards and unlock the Interdictor, Battlefield 6's longest-range sniper rifle, through the Battle Pass.

The update also expands Tsuru Reef with playable aircraft carriers, bringing the reimagined Carrier Strike experience to Battlefield's biggest map yet.

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community.  Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

snippet.title: Mafia: The Omertà Collection - Announce Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Experience four eras of organized crime in Mafia: The Omertà Collection, a new bundle featuring all four Mafia games and current-generation updates to Mafia: Definitive Edition, including 60 FPS and technical improvements.

Mafia: Definitive Edition comes to PlayStation 5 tomorrow, August 14, 2026.

Mafia: The Omertà Collection includes:
• Mafia: The Old Country Definitive Edition, including the Man of Honor expansion and Deluxe content
• Mafia: Definitive Edition, including the PS5® version with 60 FPS gameplay and technical improvements
• Mafia II: Definitive Edition, including all DLC
• Mafia III: Definitive Edition, including all DLC

Step into the shoes of men bound to the Family across decades of mob history in these immersive, third-person action-adventures rich with cinematic storytelling.

Each game in the critically acclaimed Mafia series lets you live the life of a gangster in stunningly detailed, period-accurate environments. Embrace the power and respect earned through loyalty to the Family. Endure the hardships and betrayals that define these unforgiving criminal underworlds. 

When you swear the oath to become a made-man, you commit your life to Omertà, a code of honor and silence that demands everything and forgives nothing. Do every job that's asked of you. Take what you're owed. And eliminate anyone who stands in your way...all for the Family.

-------------------------------------------------
MAFIA: THE OLD COUNTRY - DEFINITIVE EDITION
-------------------------------------------------
Sicily, 1904. Uncover the origins of organized crime as you fight to survive and prove your worth to the Family. After a brutal childhood of forced labor, Enzo Favara will risk everything to become a man of honor in the Torrisi crime family. His oath to the Mafia, with all the power, temptation, and hardship it entails, is a burning reminder of this simple truth: Family Takes Sacrifice.

-------------------------------------------------
MAFIA: THE OLD COUNTRY - MAN OF HONOR DLC
-------------------------------------------------
Sicily, 1905. In the months since his initiation, Enzo Favara has proven himself a reliable soldier of the Torrisi crime family. Now the Don entrusts him and Cesare with a delicate assignment: assist Ennio Salieri, a man of honor recently released from prison and intent on reclaiming what is his. At Salieri's side, Enzo is drawn deeper into the Valle Dorata's volatile underworld, where loyalty is tested, debts are settled, and every move carries weight.

-------------------------------------------------
MAFIA: DEFINITIVE EDITION
-------------------------------------------------
Lost Heaven, 1930. Rise through the ranks of the Mafia during the Prohibition era. After an inadvertent brush with the mob, Tommy Angelo is reluctantly thrust into the world of organized crime. Initially uneasy about falling in with the Salieri family, the rewards become too big to ignore.

-------------------------------------------------
MAFIA II: DEFINITIVE EDITION
-------------------------------------------------
Empire Bay, 1943. Live the life of a gangster during the golden age of organized crime. War hero Vito Scaletta becomes entangled with the mob in hopes of repaying his father's debts. Alongside his buddy Joe, Vito works to prove himself, climbing the Family ladder by committing crimes of increasingly larger reward and consequence.

-------------------------------------------------
MAFIA III: DEFINITIVE EDITION
-------------------------------------------------
New Bordeaux, 1968. Avenge a devastating betrayal amid the thriving crime rackets of the American southeast. After years of combat in Vietnam, Lincoln Clay's surrogate family, the Black Mob, is double-crossed and killed by the Italian Mafia. Lincoln builds a new family upon the ashes of the old, blazing a path of revenge through the mafiosi responsible.

#ps5 #ps5games #MafiaGame #MafiaTheOmertaCollection

Rated Mature

snippet.title: When the Desert Fox Hunted Desert Rats
snippet.description:
Follow and Wishlist our game on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3606970?utm_source=0245

May 27th, 1942. General Erwin Rommel leads hundreds of Panzers and ten thousand vehicles of the Afrika Korps charging across the Libyan Desert, around the flank of the British-held Gazala Line, aiming for the vital Allied port of Tobruk. Spearheading the attack of the 15th Panzer Division is a veteran Panzer commander, Capt. Johannes ‘The Lion of Capuzzo’ Kümmel in his Panzer III Ausf. J. Driving northward, his Panzers run straight into the Desert Rats of the British 7th Armored Division. The British M3 Stuart light tanks, led by Lt. Bill Close of the 3rd Royal Tank Regiment, are no match for the formidable Panzers. But the Allies have a trick up their sleeve - the brand new American-made M3 Grant tanks, which the Germans have never fought before. In a titanic battle under the scorching Sun, the desert becomes a tank graveyard with heavy losses on both sides. But the ‘Desert Fox’ Rommel outfoxes the British and emerges victorious.

Sources:

Close, Bill (2013). Tank Commander: From the Fall of France to the Defeat of Germany – The Memoirs of Bill Close.
Forczyk, Robert (2023). Desert Armour: Tank Warfare in North Africa: Gazala to Tunisia, 1942–43.
Ford, Ken and White, John (2008). Gazala 1942: Rommel’s Greatest Victory.
Forty, George (1997). The Armies of Rommel.
Forty, George (2003). 7th Armoured Division: The 'Desert Rats'.
Jörgensen, Christer (2015). Rommel’s High Tide: Gazala 1942.
Liddell Hart, B. H., editor (1953). The Rommel Papers.
Pimlott, John, editor (2014). Rommel: In His Own Words.

snippet.title: Marvel's Wolverine Preview: Not The Superhero Revelation That Spider-Man Was, But Still Fun So Far
snippet.description:
If Insomniac has proved anything over the last eight years, it’s that they know how to make a hell of a superhero game. Marvel's Spider-Man remains one of the PlayStation 4’s defining action games and a shining example of open-world design, as are both of its follow-ups. Now they’re looking to replicate that magic with Marvel's Wolverine, albeit this time as a traditional linear AAA action game. I got to play about two and half hours at a recent preview event, and while my impressions are mostly glowingly positive, I did come away with a few questions and concerns. Previewed by Mitchell Saltzman

snippet.title: Fixing Houses With Zero Qualifications in Low-Budget Repairs
snippet.description:
Welcome to Low-Budget Repairs. Manage renovations in 90s apartment blocks! Focus on quick profit and cut costs wherever possible. Client notices defects? Tough luck, the money's already in your pocket. Every day brings new challenges and decisions that can lead to fortune... or trouble! In this episode I explore my new home and meet some of the interesting local residents. I hope you enjoy this episode of Low-Budget Repairs, thanks for watching and liking.

More Low-Budget Repairs: Coming Soon.

About Low-Budget Repairs:

Imagine yourself as a DIY handyman, running your own small business in a Polish block of flats during the 1990s. Your mission? To make as much money as possible by cutting costs wherever you can!

Diluting paint with water to make it last for the entire apartment? Sure, the color might not be as vibrant, but who’s going to notice?

Laying tiles without a level? A bit of unevenness adds "character" to the space. After all, what matters is the quick result, not perfection!

Don’t worry—if the client spots any flaws after you’ve left, the profit is already yours!

Furniture doesn’t fit through the door? No problem—quick thinking, open the window, and… everything flies out into the yard! Clean room and a happy client… as long as they didn’t park under the window.

In the hardware store, you’ll be like a seasoned hunter, searching for the cheapest tools that will “sort of” get the job done. A hammer on sale that barely lasts a few hits? Grab two!

After the job’s done, take pride in your work—just ignore those little imperfections!

Take on various renovation and repair jobs. Fixing a flooded bathroom, or maybe a complete remodel? Every day is a new challenge, and every decision can bring a quick profit… or a cascade of problems.

snippet.title: [UR] PMWC at EWC 26 Finals D1 | PUBG MOBILE WORLD CUP at 2026 ESPORTS WORLD CUP
snippet.description:
Paris. $3,000,000. One Crown. PUBG MOBILE World Cup at 2026 Esports World Cup ke Finals ab shuru ho chuke hain!

Duniya ki behtareen teams championship crown ke liye aamne saamne hain, lekin is baar ek naya twist hai. Kya champion ka faisla SMASH RULE ke zariye hoga?

Kai dinon ki sakht competition ke baad duniya ki top 16 PUBG MOBILE teams ne Finals mein apni jagah bana li hai. Ab har team glory, legacy aur $3,000,000 ke prize pool mein apne hissa ke liye muqabla karegi. Yehi woh lamha hai jiske liye har team ne mehnat ki hai. Group Stage ki behtareen teams aur Survival Stage se qualify karne wali teams ab saal ke sab se intense showdown mein aamne saamne hongi. Teen din, SMASH RULE, aur sirf ek champion.

Safar apni manzil par pohanch chuka hai, lekin trophy sirf ek hi team uthayegi aur apna naam PUBG MOBILE ki tareekh mein hamesha ke liye likhwa degi. Finals ka aaghaz ho chuka hai!

🔥 SMASH RULE kaise kaam karta hai?
Finals ke Day 2 ke baad Match Point Threshold ka taayun #1 ranked team ke total points +10 ke mutabiq kiya jayega. Jo team is threshold tak pohanch jayegi, usay Finals ke aakhri din kisi baad wale match ko jeetna hoga taake championship apne naam kar sake. Jis match mein team threshold hasil karegi, usi match ko jeetne se championship nahi milegi. Agar Match 18 tak koi team SMASH RULE ke zariye champion na ban sake, to phir standard rules ke mutabiq sab se zyada total points wali team champion qarar di jayegi.

🔥 PMWC at EWC 26 miss kyun nahi karna chahiye?

Paris mein duniya ki top PUBG MOBILE teams ko glory ke liye larte dekhein!
Har match high-stakes hoga jahan har point bohat ahmiyat rakhta hai.
Apni pasandeeda team aur region ko support karein jab woh $3,000,000 aur championship crown ke liye khelain.
Finals mein exciting SMASH RULE format ka maza uthayein!

📅 TOURNAMENT SCHEDULE
Group Stage: August 6 - 9
Survival Stage: August 11 - 12
Finals: August 14 - 16

PUBG MOBILE abhi try karein: https://pubgmobile.go.link/26pmwc

💰 Kull Inami Raqam: $3,000,000
📍 Venue: Qiddiya City Grid, Paris, France
